validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed by multiple independent sources. This is Package 1 (Western Region Pipeline) of Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 2 (MGS-2). DMS Projects (independent projects database, PRJ00021818) describes '422 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the East West Pipeline 2', Western Region, status Completed. MEED (trade press) confirms MGS-2 was three main pipeline packages won by Arkad Engineering & Construction (~$1.3bn, early 2016), EPC completed 2021, raising system capacity 8.4->12.5 bcf/d. The sheet's own cited contractor page (lamar-industrial.com / LAIC Industrial) independently describes the identical asset: 422 km, 56-in underground pipeline, Pump Station 07 near Riyadh -> Pump Station 11 near Madina, 21 valve stations, 11 thrust-bore road crossings. Three origins agree the pipe is real, none of them GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: correct as a gas transmission trunk -- it is a 56-in, 422 km line on the national Master Gas System backbone (East-West corridor), not gathering/process/feeder and not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate. It parallels the original East-West Gas Pipeline (GEM P3962, 48-in / 1200 km, 'Main Line') as the second East-West line (EWP-2), but is a physically distinct 56-in loop of a different phase and length. It is also distinct from its MGS-2 siblings (P7711 Central/Qassim, P7714/P7715 Eastern/Shedgum-Riyadh) and from GulfPub's 'Master Gas System 3 (MGS 3)' EWPS segments, which are a later, still-under-construction phase. GulfPub has no matching operating feature for this line (its MGS-2 entry is the old 16-in sales line; its 56-in EWPS segments are MGS-3 construction). ATTRIBUTION: Owner=Aramco confirmed (MGS is Aramco's national gas transmission system; DMS titles it 'Saudi Aramco - Master Gas System Expansion'). GEM's PipelineNetworkGroupingAlt='MGS II' matches MEED's 'MGS-2'. Note: Owner [ref] is currently blank in the operators/owners tab -- filled below.

validity.recommendation: Length/diameter/endpoints are solid (leave). Re-point Status [ref] and Start [ref] off lamar (a subcontractor page giving a conflicting 2018 date and $536M) onto DMS+MEED. validity.researcher_notes: SPEC audit vs >=2 independent sources: LENGTH 422 km -- HIGH, agreed by lamar, DMS, and the MEED/DMS search summary. DIAMETER 56 in -- HIGH, agreed by all three. ENDPOINTS Pump Station 07 (near Riyadh) -> Pump Station 11 (near Madina) -- confirmed by lamar and DMS ('on East West Pipeline 2'). STATUS operating -- confirmed: DMS marks it Completed and MEED says MGS-2 EPC completed 2021. STARTYEAR 2021 -- supported by MEED ('completed in 2021'); however the sheet's own Status [ref] (lamar/LAIC) conflicts, giving award 2015 / completion 2018. lamar appears to be a subcontractor-scope page and is the outlier; the weight of independent evidence (MEED + DMS 'Completed', system reaching 12.5 bcf/d target ~2021) supports 2021. COST $820M (USD) -- the metenders source GEM cites is the whole MGS-2 Phase-2 project, and the value did not render for the verifier; the Western Region package is widely reported at 'just over $827 million' (DMS/MEED search), so $820M is in the right ballpark but ~$7M low and not cited to a package-specific figure; lamar's $536.05M is an outlier subcontractor figure. Net: no material error, but the Status/date/cost refs lean on a weak subcontractor page (lamar) that actively disagrees on date and cost -- re-point them to DMS+MEED. CAPACITY left blank correctly: the 12.5 bcf/d figure is whole-system MGS capacity, not attributable to this single line -- do not populate.

routes.start_name: Pump Station 07 (central region, 'near Riyadh' per sources)

waypoints.name: Buraydah / Al-Qassim area (Pump Station 06, sibling row P7711 'Qassim PS')

routes.corridor_desc: Follows the established Master Gas System / East-West Pipeline right-of-way (this line is the second East-West line, 'East West Pipeline 2') across the central Najd plateau from Pump Station 07 westward to Pump Station 11 in the Madina region, en route to the western/Red Sea coast. Exact pump-station coordinates are not published; the 422 km segment length rules out PS-07 sitting at Riyadh city (Riyadh->Madina straight-line is ~850 km), so PS-07 lies well west of Riyadh in the central Najd -- roughly between the Al-Qassim area (where sibling PS-06 sits, per P7711) and Madina. End (PS-11) anchored loosely to the Madina region. Bound is corridor-level, not meter-level.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from lamar (PS-07 near Riyadh -> PS-11 near Madina) and DMS ('422 km of 56-in pipeline on the East West Pipeline 2'). Corridor follows the existing East-West Pipeline ROW, which GEM already carries as P3962 ('East-West Gas Pipeline / Main Line'); a mapper could trace P7712's corridor from the EWP-2 right-of-way parallel to P3962 between PS-07 and PS-11, which would support 'medium'. Madina anchored to the city (24.47N, 39.61E, a real place) as a loose end point; PS-07's exact coordinate is unpublished so lat/lon left null rather than fabricated -- it lies in the central Najd well west of Riyadh given the 422 km length. Qassim/Buraydah (26.33N, 43.97E) given as a real-place waypoint marking the adjacent PS-06 on the corridor. No coordinates were invented.

summary: P7712 confirmed real (MGS-2 Package 1, Western Region Pipeline; 422 km / 56-in East-West Pipeline 2 loop) via DMS Projects + MEED + contractor page; correctly classified gas transmission trunk, not a duplicate; caveat: Status/date/cost refs lean on a weak subcontractor page (lamar) that disagrees (2018/$536M) vs the corroborated 2021/~$827M, and Owner [ref] was missing (filled to Aramco).
